verdict.rationale: Jan's privacy docs state there is zero data collection unless the user opts in, and models can run entirely on local hardware. Together these keep user data away from any training pipeline, but Jan never explicitly addresses training use, and cloud-model integrations send data to third-party providers whose policies Jan does not govern. missing for 10: explicit no-training policy statement, documented opt-in/opt-out control for training use, guidance on training exposure when using cloud providers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
